assessment_pack.assessment_title: Grade 10 Dance Studies: First Opportunity CAPS-Aligned Assessment
assessment_pack.subject: Dance Studies

sections.title: Performance Assessment Task
sections.instructions: Prepare and perform the required sequence under educator supervision. The educator records observable performance evidence against the rubric.
sections.stimulus: Use classroom-taught technique, movement vocabulary, composition principles, and safe dance practice.

questions.question: Perform the prepared practical sequence according to the task brief and safety conditions.
memo: Assess observable technique, control, accuracy, spatial use, and performance readiness.

questions.question: Present a short oral or written reflection on movement choices, style, and improvement.
memo: Credit correct terminology, relevant reflection, and links to the studied dance context.

rubric.descriptor: Accurate, controlled, safe execution of required movement vocabulary.
Clear movement structure with effective use of space, timing, dynamics and transitions.
Committed, focused performance with appropriate expressive intent.
Clear reflection using relevant subject vocabulary and evidence from the performed work.

teacher_review_checklist: Confirm CAPS topic scope and phase appropriateness.
Confirm all marks reconcile before use.
Confirm the assessment form matches the subject and phase.
Approve learner-facing wording and memo before classroom use.
